change_summary: Opt-in native MLB player/inning scenario research, same-draw per-offer census and synthetic regression workflow; frozen RUN IT model and production pricing unchanged.
assumptions: Batter BA, ISO and HR/PA are independently captured source rates rather than inferred from bookmaker lines; missing, inconsistent or invalid rates fail closed.
Base-running advancement is intentionally simplified, missing batter BB% falls back to a labelled league rate and the shared model is uncalibrated; synthetic tests cannot certify MLB outcomes.
Any simulated game still tied after the 12th inning blocks full-game market pricing rather than silently deleting unresolved draws.
Pitcher K/OUTS, real player opportunity, verified pregame source clocks, original betting odds, CLV and genuine validation remain unsupported.
Synthetic test fixtures are normalized only inside CI to make artificial BA/ISO/HR rates coherent; this must never be applied to real inputs.

baseline.metric: Shared PA/inning research bridge and scenario test suite before this PR
